kv-prompt-eyedropper.initial_request: Add an eyedropper trigger to the KV Generator prompt input (KvChat's KvLexicalEditor). When activated, the user samples a color from anywhere on screen — including other KV boards/images — and the result becomes available in the currently active prompt field. Context: users want to reference an exact color from another generated image; today the only way is text description or a screenshot, both lossy. Criteria: reuse the existing EyeDropperButton (native picker, handles the S3/CORS taint issue); picked hex copied to clipboard with a toast; button hides gracefully where EyeDropper is unsupported. Open decision: direct-insert as an alternative to clipboard-copy.

Styling is hardcoded (size-8 rounded-md border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-white/80) and joined with .join(' '), so a className override cannot reliably beat rounded-md/border.

brainstorming.summary: Add an eyedropper to the KV prompt surfaces. The native-picker logic already exists in EyeDropperButton (chosen because KV board images load from S3 with no CORS headers, which taints a canvas and makes getImageData throw) and will be extracted into a useEyeDropper() hook, because EyeDropperButton's hardcoded rounded-md/border styling cannot be overridden through className - cn() in lib/utils.ts is a plain join, not twMerge. On a successful pick the normalized #RRGGBB is inserted at the caret AND copied to the clipboard, with one showToast(...,'success') confirming both; plain text was chosen over a chip node because ContentBlock is an api-validated wire format (StreamChatRequest.php:687 allows only text/selection_ref/attachment_ref, and excludeUnvalidatedArrayKeys strips unknown keys), and because ArtStyleRefNode proves a chip can render beautifully while never serializing - a color chip that does not reach the model would defeat the feature. Scope is the single KvLexicalEditor at KvChat.tsx:2688 plus the shared BoxPromptPopover in boxPromptUi.tsx, which reaches both live region-prompt surfaces; KvKonvaCanvas's private duplicate is skipped as the fail-open KV_MULTI_BOARD legacy fallback, matching how the comment tool was handled. Neither popover closes on blur or outside-click, so the native picker will not dismiss them. The composer needs a new imperative-insert Lexical plugin (only InitialTextPlugin writes in today) and onMouseDown preventDefault so the trigger does not steal the editor selection. Verified 2026-09-09 that EyeDropper is permanently Chromium-only - Mozilla's position is negative and WebKit has never signalled - so the hidden-button gap for Safari/Firefox is structural, not a lag, and no canvas-sampling fallback is possible without fixing the S3 CORS headers. A new trackKv* PostHog event is required; no color/eyedropper event exists in kv-generator-events.ts.

decisions.answer: Insert plain-text #RRGGBB at the caret AND copy to clipboard; single toast confirms both.
decisions.why: Serializes through the existing 'text' ContentBlock, so it reaches the model with zero api change. Needs a new imperative-insert Lexical plugin plus onMouseDown preventDefault on the trigger so the picker does not steal the editor selection.

decisions.answer: KvChat composer + the shared BoxPromptPopover. KvKonvaCanvas's private duplicate is SKIPPED.
decisions.why: One edit to boxPromptUi.tsx covers both live region-prompt surfaces (Fabric canvas + resize tiles). Konva is the fail-open kill-switch fallback and already skips Fabric-only features like the comment tool; backporting would be the 4-renderer drift pattern again.

decisions.answer: Extract a useEyeDropper() hook; EyeDropperButton keeps its current look for ColorPickerPanel, each new call site renders its own trigger.
decisions.why: EyeDropperButton hardcodes rounded-md/border/bg-white/5 joined with .join(' '), and cn() in lib/utils.ts is a plain join not twMerge, so className cannot override. A hook keeps the AbortError/normalizeHex/feature-detect logic in one place without a growing variant matrix.

kv-agentic-canvas.initial_request: As a user, I want to just chat with the AI about what I want changed or added, and have it actually make the change directly on the canvas itself - across every relevant board or size on its own - instead of me manually applying each edit one board at a time. User sends one instruction in chat. The AI reads the current canvas/board context, executes the change directly across every relevant board or size on its own, and reports back what it did when finished - without the user repeating the edit per board.

brainstorming.summary: Build a structured intent layer in front of the KV canvas agent instead of growing per-case regex backstops. A one-shot resolver (house pattern Agent(output_schema), like kv_generator/edit_intent.py) turns each canvas turn into CanvasIntent: action, references with candidate layers and confidence, targets with their source, params, and needs_clarification. A deterministic validator then writes through the existing canvas tools, asks with a card built from the candidates, or hands the turn to today's agent for brainstorm and pixel edits; the target-card, which-layer and reference-guard backstops fold into it, while the stale-history filter and the FR-37b write guard stay as a final safety net. The resolver sees richer context: the canvas selection (already sent since p0), lazily generated per-layer visual descriptions cached in a side table keyed by asset hash, and a structured summary of recent runs from kv_agent_runs. Card answers return as a structured card_answer so a clarification resolves exactly. Clarifications, fast undos and refused mismatches are recorded in a kv_intent_events table and as PostHog events, and feed an exported golden set. brainstorming.summary: Add @-mentions of message attachments to AskFRND and KV Generator chat, additively. Typing @ lists files attached to the current message alongside existing mention types; picking inserts an ID-bearing chip at the caret; the same file may be mentioned many times; chips keep position in the sent bubble and history. Architecture: shared editor-agnostic core in web (ContentBlock/AttachmentRef types moved out of kvChatBlocks, MentionPopover 'Attachments' section with suffix+thumbnail disambiguation, one AttachmentMentionChip with dark/light variants, one blocks renderer for bubbles/history) plus two thin adapters: a Lexical @ typeahead plugin for KV and an ID-bearing chip + blocks serializer for MentionRichEditor (applied to all its composers: ChatInputMobile, ChatInput, HomeBriefingComposer, ProjectRoomComposer). KV: attach flow unchanged (attach chip × removes file and all its chips); @-inserted chips × remove only that node; removing a file removes every mention; add mutation listener so Backspace on chips stays consistent; Region N and art-style chips unchanged. Repeated attachment_ref already accepted by StreamChatRequest (in_array check, no distinct). AskFRND: tray unchanged; files get a client temp UUID at pick time sent alongside files[] and mapped by api; send adds optional message_blocks while keeping message string; history returns blocks + file ids; legacy threads fall back to current render; edit keeps attachment chips read-only. API: persist blocks + file ids for AskFRND, accept non-image attachment refs via client-id mapping, message nullable when blocks present, MessageBlocksFlattener Phase 2 substitutes attachment_ref with positional labels like @[Attachment N: name], ChatHelper returns file ids. ai-service: label each image/file with a text part ([Attachment N: name]) aligned with prompt tokens in chat_agent process_message_with_files and kv_generator _agno_chat_stream (account for synthetic current-kv at index 0); no provider interleaving (Agno drops list content on Gemini). Everything gated by a new feature flag; flag off or no attachment mention = payload identical to today.

The graph lives in Yjs on the existing Hocuspocus server with one writer per field: client writes intent, server writes facts. A new Composition model (base image + layers + motion + variants with sparse per-property overrides) is a standalone pillar consumed by Image, Size set, focus mode, motion and export, adapting to KV's kv_generations and pipelines instead of changing them; it replaces KV resize's whole-snapshot override model for Studio only. A Studio-owned run engine in api runs nodes one at a time with up-front price, versioned outputs, input-hash staleness and list fan-out, delegating model calls to ai-service and KV endpoints; the Workflows engine is not reused because it compiles whole DAGs, bills after the fact and has no fan-out.
